title: postHealthCheck passes only if the collateral without rescue units covers the debt at max(1.00, the optional per-market hard floor, minHealthFactor), exactly, whether the hard floor is off (0) or set within bounds
Witness: with the hard floor off, a borrow leaving hfEx exactly 1.00 with no rescue units passes
SPEC-CF-005 example: E = 3.12e28, subtraction 0.0312e18, hfEx = 1.1688e18; borrowing back to Aave hf 1.00 gives hfEx 0.974 and reverts
Every Adapter path that can lower an indebted account's health ends with postHealthCheck or the repay-with-collateral direction check; the unchecked paths run only at zero debt
The Adapter's debt-free test (Spoke borrowCount == 0) is exact: no indebted account takes the unchecked path and no debt-free account the gated one, for any MarketRegistry

Repay, the debt-free branches of withdraw and removeLiquidity, repayAllAndWithdraw, burnSeized and the deleverage callbacks read no MarketRegistry, RiskModule, ParameterStore or oracle state; every new-activity path does read the registry
Repay succeeds whenever Aave allows it and the payer funds it, for every pause state and reason, payer or borrower freeze, breaker and MarketRegistry implementation

Repay pulls min(maxRepaySpend, live debt) for a partial repay and maxRepaySpend for a repay-all, refunds received - spent, nets exactly the live debt for a fee-free repay-all, and moves nothing at zero debt
REQ-PROXY-083 example: Aave takes 3,024,657,535 and 2,005,342,465 return to the borrower

A borrow passes preBorrowCheck only if every collateral market is Live, fresh and unbroken, no collateral reserve is paused or frozen, every debt price is GHO's or a Live, fresh DebtOracle on the recorded source, the borrowed reserve's debt breaker is clear, an active keeper exists, with no drift and Hub shares == assets
Witness: a two-market, three-reserve account (GHO and a Live DebtOracle reserve) passes preBorrowCheck
A withdraw-with-debt passes preWithdrawCheck only under the same gates except Offboarding and Aave-frozen collateral, and with the debt breaker of every held reserve clear
The borrowed reserve's price source, DebtOracle state and freshness are checked even before the account holds that debt
T-60 as scoped: with the reviewed RiskModule no borrow completes against a paused or frozen collateral reserve; with any RiskModule Aave refuses a paused or frozen borrowed reserve

A pledge admitted through an exemption (Paused(General), a frozen caller, a tripped market breaker, the pool-share cap or minPledgeUsd above $10) is a rescue top-up: indebted, below the rescue target HF 1.10, charged at most its restore amount and worth at least min(minPledgeUsd, $10); and every such rescue passes unless the reason is MintPathSuspect
REQ-RISK-066 example: restoreBooked = 266,666,666,667 ($2,666.67); a $2,000 rescue passes, a $3,000 one reverts NotRescueTopUp; at price8 80,000,000 the restore amount is 333,333,333,334
borrowNonce rises by exactly 1 per successful borrow, is unchanged by a reverted one, and admits one borrow per nonce value
A wallet's pledge, borrow or withdrawal can act only on its own proxy, never on another wallet's account
